source: Three articles read in full on 26 Oct 2026. The scheduled updater replaces this list with a live feed.

items.title: Gold Falls Below $4,000 as Market Focuses on Fed and September PCE After Consecutive Adjustments
items.summary: Spot gold slipped under $4,000 after its biggest weekly drop since June. The article points to roughly 78% odds of another Fed hike in December (CME FedWatch), oil-linked inflation worries, and forced selling. The Fed meets 27 to 28 October and September PCE is due 29 October.

items.title: Gold steadies near one-week low as oil-driven inflation fears grow
items.summary: Higher oil prices tied to Middle East tensions revived inflation worries and pushed traders toward expecting Fed rate hikes, which weighs on gold because it pays no interest.

items.title: Ringgit Forecast Revised To 4.00 As Geopolitical Risks Persist
items.summary: Kenanga Research now expects the ringgit at RM4.00 per US dollar by end-2026 (previously RM3.95), citing a stronger dollar, higher US yields and geopolitical tension. It expects one more Fed hike late this year.
